Your ads are working. That's not the real question.

The real question is whether every dollar you spend turns into a closed job, or disappears somewhere between the click and the close.

The Ad ROI Calculator is one of three free tools built to answer that. No signup, no card, just your own numbers.

Run it before you raise your budget. Find the leak first, then spend more into it.
